First, note the date format: 03-09-1228 is likely DD-MM-YYYY, so 3rd September 1228.  
Adding 321 days:  
September 1228 has 30 days → 27 days left in September → 321 - 27 = 294 days left.  
October (31), November (30), December (31) = 92 days → 294 - 92 = 202 days left into 1229.  
1229 is not a leap year (leap year rule for Julian calendar in 1228: divisible by 4 → yes, but 1229 not divisible by 4 → not leap).  
January 31, February 28, March 31, April 30, May 31, June 30 = 181 days → 202 - 181 = 21 days left → into July.  
So July 21, 1229.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1229-07-21
